diagnosis: The metadata inspection endpoint runs DuckDB's parquet_metadata(?) function against a user-supplied file_path to inspect Parquet file structure, row group distribution, and row counts. It never checks if file_path resides within current_user.tenant_id's storage silo, leaking metadata about table sizes and storage architecture of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /analytics/lakehouse/metadata/parquet-info?file_path=/mnt/lake/tenants/competitor_co/transactions.parquet HTTP/1.1
Host: lake-explorer.internal.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
